option_relations.rationale: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB) is a broader category that includes Revertant Mosaicism in Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) is a type of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa, which can present with revertant mosaicism.
The option 'Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa with Revertant Mosaicism' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Revertant Mosaicism in Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa'.

The option 'Severe generalized recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism' is a more specific description of the leaf 'Revertant Mosaicism in Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa', making it clinically equivalent in this context.
